Fix: On native audio_extract_failed or unsupported_media, create an independent libmpv audio-only decoder using same source URL/HTTP headers/audio track, export bounded 55s WAV with mpv pcm AO, validate RIFF/WAVE size, send WAV file to iOS Speech recognizer, clean up temp audio in all paths; never modify original video playback or submit movie audio to Apple unless user explicitly consents. Keep source/episode epoch guards, multi-cue matching, no unreliable subtitle adjustment.
Workflow iOS-only, signed iOS 15 TrollStore IPA with tests, ad hoc codesign verification, Telegram document with accurate What's new / Fixed caption, unique permanent GitHub Release and SHA256SUMS. Use primary Intel Mac runner and bounded fallback only for no-runner cancellations.
Build number expected 148 (speech release run #3); keep previous #145/#146/#147 signed IPA releases and existing Windows #145 untouched; do not trigger paired Windows release or duplicate native jobs.
